name: BUG-2 — paywall must survive rotation
description:
Each scenario asserts the CORRECT behaviour for a bug from BUGS.md, so it is red while the
  bug is still present and shows up in the Allure report under "Known bugs — still present".
  CI does not fail on these known failures, only on new ones; when a known-bug scenario turns
  green the bug is fixed and CI asks to remove the tag.
